title: Beyond Basic Underlines: Master CSS 'text-decoration' for Superior UI & Web Font UX
tweet: Elevate your UI design beyond basic underlines! Master CSS 'text-decoration' properties like thickness & offset for enhanced readability, accessibility, and a superior user experience with your web fonts. #CSSTypography #UIDesign #WebFonts #UXDesign
tip: Leverage 'text-decoration-thickness' and 'text-underline-offset' to prevent underlines from clashing with descenders, significantly improving readability and visual harmony in your UI design. This subtle refinement enhances the overall user experience.
